title: CopyList
description: What `cp -o json` prints: one record per source examined, in the order the copies were attempted. `cp -o yaml` is the same document. A refusal is a record with `action: failed` and its `error`.

source.description: The source as named on the command line, or the path below an operand.

target.description: Where the copy went, or would have gone.

type.description: The source's kind; `unknown` when it could not be examined.

action.description: created: the target did not exist and does now. replaced: it existed and holds the source now. merged: an existing directory received the tree below the source. skipped: -i was answered with anything but y. planned: --dry-run, nothing written. failed: not copied, see error.

size.description: Files only: the bytes copied (or that would be, under --dry-run).

error.description: Why the copy failed, as printed on standard error after `cp: `.
